"""Compare three incident/motion force columns using compact volume integrals."""
import argparse,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'software/stage1_solver/tools'))
import numpy as np
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.sparse.linalg import splu
from mouth_carrier_lateral_response import Dipole, prepare, weighted_gram, surface, trace
from mouth_empty_bend_stiffness import quadrature
from mouth_carrier_lateral_inertia import WINDOWS,taper
from mouth_occupied_push_baths import load_bath,digest
from mouth_occupied_push_flux import face_points
from mouth_carrier_free_center import wall_row
p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--source',type=Path)
p.add_argument('--nested',type=Path)
p.add_argument('--saved',type=Path,required=True)
args=p.parse_args()
if args.source:dom,base=prepare(args)
else:dom,base=load_bath(args.nested)
with np.load(args.saved) as saved:
 np.testing.assert_array_equal(saved['points'],dom.points)
 assert saved['background_sha256'].item()==digest((args.nested or args.source)/'field.npz')
 w=float(saved['omega'])
 u=np.r_[saved['harmonic_real'],saved['harmonic_imag']]
model=Dipole(dom,base)
r,z,radial,axial=quadrature(dom)
f=dom.N@base; fr=radial@(base-1); fz=axial@(base-1)
weights=dom.weight/3
mass=weighted_gram(dom.N,dom.weight); J=sparse.bmat([[None,-mass],[mass,None]],format='csr')
op=model.operator-1j*w*J
unknown=model.free; lu=splu(op[unknown][:,unknown].tocsc())
faces=[(1,'v',dom.far,(1.,0.)),(4,'p',1.,(1.,0.)),(3,'v',dom.roof,(0.,1.)),(4,'v',dom.roof,(0.,1.))]
def ri(x):return [x.real,x.imag]
def component(h):
 g=dom.N@h; gr=radial@h; gz=axial@h
 px=np.imag(np.conj(g)*fr+np.conj(f)*(gr+2*g/r))
 e1=np.real(np.conj(fr)*gr+np.conj(fz)*gz+.5*(np.abs(f)**8-1)*np.conj(f)*g)
 t1=np.imag(np.conj(f)*g)
 s_r=np.real(np.conj(fr)*gr+np.conj(gr+2*g/r)*fr)-e1
 s_w=np.real(np.conj(fr)*gz+np.conj(gr+2*g/r)*fz)
 loc=[]
 for lo,hi,bot,top in WINDOWS:
  ar,dr=taper(r,lo,hi); az,dz=taper(z,bot,top)
  loc.append([weights@(ar*az*px),weights@(s_r*dr*az+s_w*ar*dz),weights@(dr*az*t1)])
 port=[];bt=[]
 for block,along,fixed,normal in faces:
  old,_=surface(dom,np.column_stack((base,h)),block,along,fixed,normal)
  a,b,dq=face_points(dom,block,along,fixed)
  rr,_,rp,rv,wp,wv,vals,*_=trace(dom,block,a,b,np.column_stack((base,h)))
  tr,tw=(rp,wp) if along=='p' else (rv,wv)
  nr=tw*np.sign(tw*normal[0]-tr*normal[1])
  port.append(old);bt.append(4*np.pi/3*np.sum(dq*rr**2*nr*np.imag(np.conj(vals[:,0])*vals[:,1])))
 return np.r_[weights@px,np.ravel(loc),np.ravel(port),np.ravel(bt)]
legacy_static,legacy_time,boost=wall_row(dom,base)
force={}
for label,drive in [('feed',dom.feed),('bulk',dom.bulk),('motion',None)]:
 if drive is None:
  sol=u
 else:
  delta=1j*dom.points[:,0]*base*drive
  sol=np.r_[delta.real,delta.imag].astype(complex)
  sol[unknown]=lu.solve(-(op@sol)[unknown])
 hr,hi=np.split(sol,2)
 t=component(hr.real+1j*hi.real)+1j*component(hr.imag+1j*hi.imag)
 momentum=t[0]; loc=t[1:7].reshape(2,3);flux=t[7:11];rate=t[11:]
 glob=1j*w*(momentum-rate.sum())+sum(flux)
 local=1j*w*(loc[:,0]+loc[:,2])-loc[:,1]
 legacy=-(legacy_static+1j*w*legacy_time)@sol - (boost if drive is None else 0)
 force[label]=glob
 print(json.dumps(dict(omega=w,case=label,sha256=digest(args.saved),full=ri(glob),compact=list(map(ri,local)),legacy=ri(legacy),port_time=ri(-1j*w*sum(rate)),storage=ri(1j*w*momentum))),flush=True)
print(json.dumps(dict(omega=w,observables='independent actuator per unit V or incident U',entrance_push=ri(1j*w/force['motion']),entrance_free_stream=ri(-1j*w*force['feed']/force['motion']))))

p.add_argument('--nested',type=Path)

args=p.parse_args()

 assert saved['background_sha256'].item()==digest((args.nested or args.source)/'field.npz')
 w=float(saved['omega'])
 u=np.r_[saved['harmonic_real'],saved['harmonic_imag']]

r,z,radial,axial=quadrature(dom)
f=dom.N@base; fr=radial@(base-1); fz=axial@(base-1)
weights=dom.weight/3
faces=[(1,'v',dom.far,(1.,0.)),(4,'p',1.,(1.,0.)),(3,'v',dom.roof,(0.,1.)),(4,'v',dom.roof,(0.,1.))]
def ri(x):return [x.real,x.imag]
def component(h):
 g=dom.N@h; gr=radial@h; gz=axial@h
 px=np.imag(np.conj(g)*fr+np.conj(f)*(gr+2*g/r))
 e1=np.real(np.conj(fr)*gr+np.conj(fz)*gz+.5*(np.abs(f)**8-1)*np.conj(f)*g)
 t1=np.imag(np.conj(f)*g)
 s_r=np.real(np.conj(fr)*gr+np.conj(gr+2*g/r)*fr)-e1
 s_w=np.real(np.conj(fr)*gz+np.conj(gr+2*g/r)*fz)
 loc=[]
 for lo,hi,bot,top in WINDOWS:
  ar,dr=taper(r,lo,hi); az,dz=taper(z,bot,top)
  loc.append([weights@(ar*az*px),weights@(s_r*dr*az+s_w*ar*dz),weights@(dr*az*t1)])
 port=[];bt=[]
 for block,along,fixed,normal in faces:
  old,_=surface(dom,np.column_stack((base,h)),block,along,fixed,normal)
  a,b,dq=face_points(dom,block,along,fixed)
  rr,_,rp,rv,wp,wv,vals,*_=trace(dom,block,a,b,np.column_stack((base,h)))
  tr,tw=(rp,wp) if along=='p' else (rv,wv)
  nr=tw*np.sign(tw*normal[0]-tr*normal[1])
  port.append(old);bt.append(4*np.pi/3*np.sum(dq*rr**2*nr*np.imag(np.conj(vals[:,0])*vals[:,1])))
 return np.r_[weights@px,np.ravel(loc),np.ravel(port),np.ravel(bt)]

from mouth_carrier_free_center import motion_source, momentum_force_rows
A,B=momentum_force_rows(dom,base,motion_source(dom,base))
rnodes,wnodes=dom.points.T
g = rnodes/dom.far
m1=g*(1+.12*wnodes/dom.roof)*np.cos(g)
m2=g*(.37+.6*np.sin(wnodes/dom.roof))
m3=g*np.cos(g*wnodes/dom.roof)
m4=g*(-.3+.51*np.sin(g+wnodes/dom.roof))
for case,sol in [('actual_tow',u),('manufactured',np.r_[m1+1j*m3,m2+1j*m4])]:
 hr,hi=np.split(sol,2)
 t=component(hr.real+1j*hi.real)+1j*component(hr.imag+1j*hi.imag)
 momentum=t[0]; flux=t[7:11]; rate=t[11:]
 new=(A+1j*w*B)@sol
 independent=1j*w*(momentum-rate.sum())+sum(flux)
 wrong_no_temporal=1j*w*momentum+sum(flux)
 print(json.dumps(dict(case=case,w=w,corrected=ri(new),independent=ri(independent),no_port_time=ri(wrong_no_temporal),resid=abs(new-independent))),flush=True)
 assert abs(new-independent)<2e-10*max(1,abs(new))
 if case=='manufactured':assert abs(new-wrong_no_temporal)>1
